entries.3335871e94a9d5af: This is a domestic business. The company and its manufacturing subsidiary Kawaki Keisoku Kogyo manufacture automatic control valves and measuring instruments; its import subsidiary Yoshitake Armstrong supplies materials for and sells overseas products; and Yoshitake Biomass Engineering sells biomass combustion furnaces and boilers, among others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,592 million.
entries.357415d114e7dfcd: This business consists of Yoshitake Works Thailand, which manufactures castings and automatic control valves in Thailand and also supplies materials to the company.

entries.c09591f790f04cb1: This business consists of Yoshitake Works Thailand, which manufactures castings and automatic control valves in Thailand and also supplies materials to the company. Sales subsidiaries in Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam and China sell the company's products locally. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,751 million.
entries.cbe7eff43fd98948: A valve manufacturer that makes automatic control valves, produces them in Japan and Thailand, and sells them to factory and building equipment customers through sales subsidiaries in Asian countries.
